# Test Set Size in Stahlberg and Byrne's *On NMT Search Errors and Model Errors: Cat Got Your Tongue?*

## Introduction and Scope of the Query

This report answers the question: **What is the test set size** used in Stahlberg and Byrne's study of search errors and model errors in neural machine translation (NMT)? The query is narrow but methodologically important, because the paper's central claims — that beam search fails to find the global best model score for more than half of sentences, and that the empty translation frequently receives the global best model score — are empirical claims whose credibility depends on the size and composition of the evaluation set on which they rest ([Stahlberg & Byrne, n.d.](document_1.txt)).
